model_output.verdict: A product designer with named app projects, but little on what changed and no recent design work listed.
write_up: Your resume points to product design: you designed apps at Loop Fitness and client work at Brightpath Studio, then moved into a barista role. It’s common for design resumes to list the work without explaining the decisions or what changed. Here, that makes it harder to stand out for a product design job, especially with no design work listed after February 2024.

The Loop Fitness design system is your best model: it names what you created, where you built it, and that it was the app’s first. Your current coffee role accounts for the time since Loop Fitness, but a recruiter will still look for signs of recent design practice.

Let’s start with the Loop Fitness booking flow. Add the design decisions you made and any result you can substantiate. Then give the usability tests and releases the same treatment. If you’ve done design projects since Loop Fitness, include the real work and dates.
